evidence: Sound mechanism plus direct data. Intra-request tensor parallelism splits one prefill's compute across GPUs, cutting the latency of the single long (~36k-token) burst prefill; independent replicas cannot subdivide one request and can only serve it whole, so a long prefill queues behind itself. DB v_pool_latency knee runs confirm the layout effect at fixed budget: burst1 tp1_base TTFT p99=1870ms vs tp2_base=748ms (2.5x); burst3 tp1_base=2769ms vs tp2_base=786ms (3.5x). The thesis's replica-matched TP1x4 vs TP2x2 (both 4xH100) 1.55-1.74x tail cut sits within this range. TP1x4 fails all five burst windows while TP2x2 passes each, a prefill floor replica scaling cannot buy down.
